verses.zh: （ 大 衛 的 金 詩 。 ） 神 啊 ， 求 你 保 佑 我 ， 因 為 我 投 靠 你 。
verses.en: A prayer of David.Protect me, O God, for I have taken shelter in you.
notes: Psalm 16. The psalmist seeks divine protection because he has remained loyal to God. He praises God for his rich blessings, and is confident God will vindicate him and deliver him from death.
The precise meaning of the Hebrew term מִכְתָּם (mikhtam) is uncertain. HALOT 582-83 s.v. defines it as “inscription.”

verses.zh: 我 的 心 哪 ， 你 曾 對 耶 和 華 說 ： 你 是 我 的 主 ； 我 的 好 處 不 在 你 以 外 。
verses.en: I say to the Lord, “You are the Lord,my only source of well-being.”
notes: Psalm 16. The psalmist seeks divine protection because he has remained loyal to God. He praises God for his rich blessings, and is confident God will vindicate him and deliver him from death.

verses.zh: 論 到 世 上 的 聖 民 ， 他 們 又 美 又 善 ， 是 我 最 喜 悅 的 。
verses.en: As for God’s chosen people who are in the land,and the leading officials I admired so much—
notes: Psalm 16. The psalmist seeks divine protection because he has remained loyal to God. He praises God for his rich blessings, and is confident God will vindicate him and deliver him from death.

verses.zh: 以 別 神 代 替 耶 和 華 的 （ 或 譯 ： 送 禮 物 給 別 　 神 的 ） ， 他 們 的 愁 苦 必 加 增 ； 他 們 所 澆 奠 的 血 我 不 獻 上 ； 我 嘴 唇 也 不 提 別 　 神 的 名 號 。
verses.en: their troubles multiply;they desire other gods. I will not pour out drink offerings of blood to their gods, nor will I make vows in the name of their gods.
notes: Psalm 16. The psalmist seeks divine protection because he has remained loyal to God. He praises God for his rich blessings, and is confident God will vindicate him and deliver him from death.
The precise meaning of the Hebrew term מִכְתָּם (mikhtam) is uncertain. HALOT 582-83 s.v. defines it as “inscription.”

The Hebrew perfect verbal form probably refers here to a completed action with continuing results (see 7:1; 11:1).sn Taken shelter. “Taking shelter” in the Lord is an idiom for seeking his protection. Seeking his protection presupposes and even demonstrates the subject’s loyalty to the Lord. In the psalms those who “take shelter” in the Lord are contrasted with the wicked and equated with those who love, fear and serve the Lord (Pss 5:11-12; 31:17-20; 34:21-22).

verses.zh: 耶 和 華 是 我 的 產 業 ， 是 我 杯 中 的 分 ； 我 所 得 的 ， 你 為 我 持 守 。
verses.en: Lord, you give me stability and prosperity; you make my future secure.
notes: Psalm 16. The psalmist seeks divine protection because he has remained loyal to God. He praises God for his rich blessings, and is confident God will vindicate him and deliver him from death.
The precise meaning of the Hebrew term מִכְתָּם (mikhtam) is uncertain. HALOT 582-83 s.v. defines it as “inscription.”

verses.zh: 用 繩 量 給 我 的 地 界 ， 坐 落 在 佳 美 之 處 ； 我 的 產 業 實 在 美 好 。
verses.en: It is as if I have been given fertile fieldsor received a beautiful tract of land.
notes: Psalm 16. The psalmist seeks divine protection because he has remained loyal to God. He praises God for his rich blessings, and is confident God will vindicate him and deliver him from death.

verses.zh: 我 必 稱 頌 那 指 教 我 的 耶 和 華 ； 我 的 心 腸 在 夜 間 也 警 戒 我 。
verses.en: I will praise the Lord who guides me;yes, during the night I reflect and learn.
notes: Psalm 16. The psalmist seeks divine protection because he has remained loyal to God. He praises God for his rich blessings, and is confident God will vindicate him and deliver him from death.

Heb “my good [is] not beyond you.” For the use of the preposition עַל (ʿal) in the sense of “beyond,” see BDB 755 s.v. 2.

verses.zh: 我 將 耶 和 華 常 擺 在 我 面 前 ， 因 他 在 我 右 邊 ， 我 便 不 致 搖 動 。
verses.en: I constantly trust in the Lord; because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
notes: Psalm 16. The psalmist seeks divine protection because he has remained loyal to God. He praises God for his rich blessings, and is confident God will vindicate him and deliver him from death.

verses.zh: 因 此 ， 我 的 心 歡 喜 ， 我 的 靈 （ 原 文 是 榮 耀 ） 快 樂 ； 我 的 肉 身 也 要 安 然 居 住 。
verses.en: So my heart rejoicesand I am happy; my life is safe.
notes: Psalm 16. The psalmist seeks divine protection because he has remained loyal to God. He praises God for his rich blessings, and is confident God will vindicate him and deliver him from death.
The precise meaning of the Hebrew term מִכְתָּם (mikhtam) is uncertain. HALOT 582-83 s.v. defines it as “inscription.”

verses.zh: 因 為 你 必 不 將 我 的 靈 魂 撇 在 陰 間 ， 也 不 叫 你 的 聖 者 見 朽 壞 。
verses.en: You will not abandon me to Sheol; you will not allow your faithful follower to see the Pit.

Heb “regarding the holy ones who [are] in the land, they; and the mighty [ones] in [whom is/was] all my desire.” The difficult syntax makes the meaning of the verse uncertain. The phrase “holy ones” sometimes refers to God’s angelic assembly (see Ps 89:5, 7), but the qualifying clause “who are in the land” suggests that here it refers to God’s people (Ps 34:9) or to their priestly leaders (2 Chr 35:3).

verses.zh: 你 必 將 生 命 的 道 路 指 示 我 。 在 你 面 前 有 滿 足 的 喜 樂 ； 在 你 右 手 中 有 永 遠 的 福 樂 。
verses.en: You lead me in the path of life. I experience absolute joy in your presence; you always give me sheer delight.
